name: Microphone
plain: Asks to record sound from the microphone.
meaning: Hears conversations, music, ambient sounds and the user's voice. A top concern because capture can run without any visible UI.

android.prompt_ui: While using the app, Only this time, Don't allow (Android 11+)
android.revocation: Settings > Apps > Permissions > Microphone; Quick Settings mic toggle (Android 12)
android.store_policy: Play: background mic use needs a foreground service of type microphone (API 30+)
android.note: Android 11 restricts mic access to foreground services started while visible.

ios.note: Orange dot in the status bar while in use (iOS 14); background audio mode keeps recording.

limits.headline: Can listen through your microphone while in use, after you tap Allow
limits.user_action: You tap Record, Voice message, or Join a call, then tap Allow
can: Record sound and your voice while the app is open
Hear music and background noise as well
Keep recording in the background on iPhone with the audio background mode, shown by an orange dot
cannot: Use the mic without an orange dot (iPhone) or green chip (Android 12 and later)
Use the mic in the background on Android 11 and later unless a visible service started in the foreground
Use it after you tap Don't Allow
limits.reach_label: While the app is open, sometimes more
limits.differs: Android 11 and later adds Only this time and limits background mic use. iPhone allows background audio with an orange dot.

story.what_it_is: Lets an app record sound from the microphone, such as your voice, music or the room.

marketing.name: Microphone indicator
marketing.pitch: iOS shows an orange dot when an app uses the microphone.

marketing.name: Microphone access
marketing.pitch: Apps need your permission and Android shows a chip when the mic is active.

story.for_you: A pop up asks 'Allow microphone?' You then talk, record or join voice chat, and a dot or chip warns you when it is on.
story.for_makers: Voice powers calls, voice notes, music recognition, voice chat in games and assistants. Capture can run without any visible screen, so both systems add indicators and limits on background use.

use_cases.example: You talk with teammates in a voice lobby during a match.
You hold a button and send a voice note.
You hold up the phone and the app names the song playing.
You speak on a live audio stage.
You record a vocal track over a beat in a music app.
You say a command to your smart speaker app.
A malicious app tries to record conversations in the background, which the indicator exposes.

story.android_note: Android lets apps record in the background only with a visible foreground service.
story.ios_note: iOS shows an orange dot and blocks background recording unless the app uses an allowed mode.

technical_bounds: Android disables background capture for apps without a foreground service
System shows an indicator on both OSes
Cannot record in background without a visible foreground service or audio session

linkedin.how: Voice messages in chat and video upload explain the permission (community discussion, Sept 2024). Play Data safety lists voice or sound recordings, music files and other audio files (all optional); Apple label lists Audio Data. No LinkedIn statement found on microphone use for ads.

history.change: Indicator chip and global mic toggle added
Background mic requires a microphone foreground service type
